entries.reason: Candidate7 self-audit found that IssueLogStore's finally-based lock release masked the primary operation error when both the operation and cleanup failed.
entries.trigger: Shared issue-log lock ordering and cleanup-failure audit before the broader focused regression.
entries.resolution: IssueLogStore now reports an ordered AggregateError with the operation as cause, preserves unchanged file bytes and mode, leaves the failed lock cleanup observable, and supports a clean retry after explicit lock release.

entries.reason: Two finalize recovery fixtures relied on a duplicate active-flow registration silently ignoring a conflicting mode after setup had already registered the worktree flow.
entries.trigger: Candidate9 registry mode invariant combined finalize regression.
entries.resolution: The fixtures now explicitly remove the helper-created entry and register the scenario's real worktree mode; all recovery assertions remain intact and the direct different-mode conflict test remains authoritative.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Recovery fixtures must seed one unambiguous active-flow mode and must not depend on duplicate registration to overwrite or ignore conflicting authority.

entries.reason: Both cherry-pick conflict paths invoked `git cherry-pick --abort` but discarded its result. An abort failure was therefore reported as a restored CHERRY_PICK_CONFLICT and detached rescue could proceed into automatic cleanup without preserving the in-progress Git authority.
entries.trigger: Candidate9 source-level audit of every auto-rescue Git mutation and result.
entries.resolution: Auto-rescue outcome and cleanup journal v2 now retain the exact abort Git result. Conflict and empty-patch skip failures both produce a primary-first AggregateError ordered as CHERRY_PICK_CONFLICT then CHERRY_PICK_ABORT_FAILED, durably publish phase abort-failed, and stop before ref update or automatic worktree cleanup. A retry reads that journal, performs cleanup only without replaying cherry-pick or abort, and removes the journal after verified cleanup.
entries.guardrailCandidate: A failed compensating Git mutation must be checked, preserved after the primary failure, and journaled before any later Git mutation; recovery may resume only from the durable authority.

entries.reason: Candidate10 found that standard finalize mutated flow, issue, plugin metadata, and the caller Git index before durable rollback authority existed, while auto-rescue still preferred a direct main checkout route.
entries.trigger: Final transaction and rescue-route audit after candidate9 commit d654d794.
entries.resolution: Finalize now publishes a bounded prepared tree before-image before mutation, restores owned bytes/mode/path sets on every pre-commit failure, restores flow.json through AtomicFlowStateWriter CAS, and compensates issue-log entries by journaled stable IDs. It builds a private 0600 isolated index from the journaled expected parent without reading or mutating the caller index, and shares the repository maintenance barrier through borrowed owner tokens. Auto-rescue always uses the detached journal route and durably records the expected new OID before ref CAS.
entries.guardrailCandidate: A recovery journal must precede its first owned mutation, Git index operations must use an isolated authority, and every ref mutation must have both expected-old and expected-new OIDs durable before execution.
testCorrections: Replaced the auto-rescue source-window CAS regex with a public detached-rescue behavior test that moves the base authority and proves update-ref cannot overwrite it.

Moved the ordered restore-failure injection from obsolete raw flow bytes to the second AtomicFlowStateWriter rename while retaining the exact primary-first AggregateError and durable-residue assertions.
Added a real-Git index observer that proves expected-parent read-tree creates a private 0600 index, cleanup removes index and lock, and caller index bytes remain unchanged.
entries.unionFailure: The first 100-file candidate10 union reported ten failures with one ENOENT root cause: legacy fake Git runners returned read-tree success without creating GIT_INDEX_FILE. Finalize now initializes the isolated index from the durable expected parent, applies mode 0600 when real Git creates it, and does not require a caller-index copy. The unchanged spec291/spec304 behavior tests then passed 19/19, the authority focused union passed 140/140, and the same 100-file manifest passed 1013/1013.

entries.reason: An independent post-candidate10 audit rejected merge because successful isolated commits left the caller index stale, checked-out base refs were not materialized, AtomicFlowStateWriter did not own the common repository barrier, shared issue-log and sidecar rollback were incomplete, and detached rescue cleanup trusted a temporary pathname without generation authority.
entries.trigger: Independent immutable-tree audit of candidate10 before commit.
entries.resolution: Finalize teardown journal v3 now commits an exact changed-path set, adopts a durable commit before reporting temp-index cleanup failure, reconciles only caller-index entries that still match the expected parent while preserving genuine staged entries, and defers reconciliation safely behind an existing index.lock. Prepared rollback covers exact spec and per-spec sidecar trees; shared flow and issue-log mutations use their writers while uncontended issue-log bytes, mode, and absence are restored exactly. Auto-rescue journal v5 keeps completed tombstones, records ref old/new authority, materializes a checked-out base worktree and index, and records worktree-directory plus Git-admin-directory inode identities and detached HEAD before cleanup. Dirty preflight exempts only the exact stable-ID conflict audit and all Git status or CHERRY_PICK_HEAD probe failures stop closed.
testCorrections: Changed finalize journal fixture version checks from v2 to v3 and before-image cardinality from one spec tree to the exact spec plus sidecar trees.

Changed the retained-metadata success fixture from incorrectly requiring sidecar metrics in Git history to the established post-command-sidecar contract, while adding exact pre-commit sidecar rollback coverage.
Changed concurrent flow-writer loser expectations to the common outer REPOSITORY_FLOW_OPERATION_BUSY boundary while preserving committed=false and all winner-byte assertions.
Changed no behavioral assertions to accept partial success; every correction targets a newly explicit transaction boundary or journal schema.
entries.result: The combined independent-audit matrix passed 170/170. The canonical project regression passed unit 2276 and integration 225.

entries.reason: The immutable audit of commit 6daec257 found that finalize advanced HEAD before acquiring the caller index lock, temporary indexes were created directly under the public temporary directory, pending auto-rescue ref journals were checked after dirty preflight, and plugin hook exceptions could still become warnings followed by success.
entries.trigger: Post-commit immutable-tree audit before merge authorization.
entries.resolution: Finalize teardown journal v4 durably plans and inode-binds a caller index lease plus a private 0700 temporary-index workspace before commit construction, retains both through commit durability and caller-index reconciliation, and reclaims an owned stale lock after SIGKILL. A foreign lock, including a race after durable intent, halts before HEAD mutation and is never deleted. Expected-tree, commit, and reconcile indexes are initialized mode 0600 inside the owned workspace. Plugin lifecycle exceptions and PLUGIN_HOOK_FAILED results now fail-stop through exact prepared rollback. Public auto-rescue resumes a pending ref-update journal before ordinary dirty preflight, materializes a checked-out base, adopts a successful CAS reported as failure only after probing the expected new OID, and reports a failed conflict-file probe as AUTO_RESCUE_CONFLICT_PROBE_FAILED rather than an ordinary conflict.
testCorrections: Changed the foreign caller index-lock fixture from accepting post-commit deferral to requiring byte-identical HEAD, index, and prepared-state restoration before retry.
Updated journal version and private-index path selectors to the v4 transaction workspace without relaxing fault, cleanup, or retry assertions.
Kept pre-outcome rescue exceptions on their established durable-residue route; only the newly owned conflict-file-probe failure performs immediate verified cleanup.

entries.reason: The immutable audit of commit 2b33c2ca found that an owned caller index lock became unrecoverable if SIGKILL landed after its marker was replaced with final index bytes but before rename, and that resumed auto-rescue treated a successful ref CAS reported as failure differently from the fresh path. It also found that finalize could adopt an unmarked empty temporary workspace created by a foreign racer after durable path intent.
entries.trigger: Second post-commit immutable-tree audit before merge authorization.
entries.resolution: Finalize teardown journal v5 records the owned lock inode, deterministic marker revision, marker/publishing phase, expected index revision, and expected mode before the first index-data write. Recovery adopts only the same inode containing either the exact marker or exact authorized index revision; it completes the close-to-rename SIGKILL window, while foreign content returns BUSY without byte mutation. Resumed auto-rescue now post-probes every nonzero update-ref result and distinguishes expected-new adoption, expected-old retry failure, and third-OID authority failure exactly like the fresh path. An unmarked EEXIST temporary workspace is never adopted or modified; the owned 0700 workspace identity is durable before exclusive temporary-index creation.
testCorrections: Updated the finalize journal-version selector from v4 to v5 so the existing post-expectation authority race remains attached to the current strict schema.
Kept the foreign index-lock content byte-preservation assertion exact while allowing failAfterCommit to durably record the BUSY result in its transaction journal.
entries.result: The strengthened serial authority union passed 197/197 before records.
